name: mindsphere-auth-helper
description: Siemens Insights Hub Authorization Helper (chrome extension).

scripts.prepare: rimraf dist/ && tsc --outdir dist/ && copyfiles -u 1 "assets/**/*" dist/assets/ &&  copyfiles -u 1 "vendor/**/*" dist/vendor/ && copyfiles manifest.json dist/ && copyfiles index.html dist/
scripts.pre-publish: cross-var "npm run prepare &&  rimraf *.zip  &&  7zz a -tzip $npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip -w dist/."

author: @sn0wcat
